blocks.content: Write a program to replace 'yt' in 'Python' with the string entered by the user.

items: Create a string named language with the value "Python".
Take string as an input for ch variable.
Use the replace() method to replace "yt" with user-entered string stored in ch.

blocks.content: Hint: Use the string replace() method. This method takes two arguments.

items: oldValue - a substring we want to replace
newValue - a substring that replaces the oldValue
